entries.zh: 凶灾祸患；憔苦愁闷、困顿忧苦
entries.en: misfortunes and calamities; troubles, toils and distress

entries.zh: 遭难受苦（指“生受”义：受苦、吃苦）
entries.en: to suffer hardship and misfortune (short for shengshou 'to suffer'); trouble
entries.notes: 单字“生”与西语 desgracias trabaxos 的对应依赖 M 栏手注 Lē / Lē siū（与“生受”条同读），字义靠交叉指引判定，故降 medium。

entries.zh: 阨难：困厄危难；灾难苦厄
entries.notes: 首字原稿疑为“阨”或“色”（[疑]标注）；据读音 ēg 与西语 desgracias trabaxos 判为“阨难”困厄义。

entries.zh: 生受：受苦、吃苦；遭难受罪
entries.en: to suffer, endure hardship; to bear misfortune and trouble

entries.zh: 疑为“迍邅（屯遭）”：命途困顿、时运不济；西语谓不幸之人
entries.en: unfortunate, unlucky (desgraciado); to be in dire straits, meet repeated setbacks
entries.notes: 首字疑为“迍/屯”、次字疑为“邅/遭”（[疑]标注），且 M 栏 fūn 与 R 栏 tūn 首音不合；据西语 desgraciado 与读音 tūn chiân 判为困顿失意义。

entries.zh: 互相抓扯扭打、撕破头脸（相斗）；兼指蓬头散乱
entries.en: to fight tearing at each other's heads (desgreñarse); to grapple and scratch; dishevelled
to demolish, tear down (derribar); to undo, take apart (deshacer)

entries.zh: 皱缩、皱乱（字义与西语对应存疑）
entries.notes: 字“卒”与西语 deshecho arrugado（皱缩凌乱）的语义对应不明，或为记音俗字，存疑降 medium。

entries.en: to strike, pounce on; to knock down, smother/extinguish
entries.notes: 西语 agolpar 的 17 世纪语义（扑击/扑灭一类）系推断，与字“撲”的对应缺直证，降 medium。

entries.en: to melt, dissolve; to blend, harmonize
entries.notes: 字栏疑为“訌/轟”，但其读音（iōng/yong）与西语 deshacerse（消融义）均指向“融/溶”类字，字形判读存疑。

entries.en: to take apart, undo; to separate, unfasten
to untie a knot; to unfasten

entries.zh: 改嫁：妇人再嫁（夫亡或离异后另嫁）
entries.en: (of a woman) to remarry; to dissolve her marriage by taking a new husband

entries.zh: 替婚：妇人再嫁、改换夫家
entries.en: (of a woman) to remarry, take a new husband

entries.zh: 替亲情：另结亲事、再嫁（“亲情”谓婚事）
entries.en: (of a woman) to remarry; to contract a new marriage

entries.zh: 绩（绩麻）：将麻缕捻搓成线，备于纺织
entries.en: to spin hemp into thread; to twist hemp fibre for weaving

entries.zh: 绩丝：捻丝成线（与上条绩麻相对）
entries.notes: 西语条重复 cáñamo（麻）而汉字为“绩丝”，当系与上条“绩麻”相对之分条，不影响释义。
